claude_proposed_widenings.name: stateful_vehicle_control_surface
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item is a controllable vehicle/object with persistent internal state changed by lever inputs, rather than a passive grant or a single bounded activation. The current magic-item families have no honest way to encode mutable lever positions, pilot-operated controls, or object-state transitions that unlock movement, attacks, shutters, lighting, and hatch state.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down. After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: vehicle_or_object_stat_block_payload
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item carries its own AC, HP, movement modes, damage immunities, occupancy, air supply, depth limit, and pressure damage. Existing spawned-creature and passive item shapes do not honestly model a piloted object/vehicle with independent stats and environment-driven damage.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The Apparatus of the Crab is a Large object with the following statistics: AC 20; HP 200; Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. (or 0 ft. if the legs aren't extended); Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.
